text: The purpose of this report is to advise Toronto City Council, pursuant to Chapter 195 of the Toronto Municipal Code (Purchasing By-law, Section 195-7.4), of a non-competitive contract with AECOM Canada Limited (AECOM) for engineering design services and contract administration related to emergency repairs to the East Don Sanitary Trunk Sewer and the Highland Creek Sanitary Trunk Sewer in the amount of $650,000 inclusive of contingency and net of all applicable taxes and charges ($661,440 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries). In addition, the issuance of an amendment to Purchase Order Number 6045596 issued to Capital Sewer Services Incorporated for the provision of the Full Length Trenchless Rehabilitation of Existing Gravity Sewers - Various Locations within Toronto (Citywide), for unanticipated additional emergency construction services (Purchase Order Amendment) required beyond the…
